fusions.name: Final Syllable
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Inscribes the last mark on it, dealing 20 damage and leaving it [Cursed] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spelled in Threes
fusions.desc: Looses 3 inscribed points in a spread, each dealing 6 damage. Holds up to 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Called Cadence
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more power for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Phrase
fusions.desc: Every ability you cast builds a stack on you, up to 5. Your next ability spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 7 seconds.
